name: Yuki
source: The second protagonist of Child Flower, she is a very tomboyish girl. She's 11 years old and attends elementary school along with her friends. She's very worried about Shiho being left alone all day and sometimes ditches school to spend time with her. She loves Ojisan very much and shares this secret with Shiho.
